zh.summary: 让 Windows 安装版可以直接在常用终端中使用官方 dsh 命令，同时保持便携版不修改系统环境。
highlights: 安装时可以选择把 dsh 加入当前用户 PATH；新开的 PowerShell 和命令提示符可直接粘贴官方插件命令。
修复安装不会产生重复项；更换安装目录会迁移旧项，取消选择或卸载只清理由安装器管理的路径。
修复刚发布的插件已经安装后，发布时间保护仍会阻止用户卸载的问题；安装新代码时的保护保持不变。
退出时清理可重建的绝对链接，避免部分 Windows 版本在移动整个便携文件夹时失败。
修复完整包升级时托盘长时间停在“正在检查”的状态；检查、确认、下载和安装现在是独立阶段，更新器会在 DSH 安全退出后校验并替换程序，再自动打开新版本且保留用户数据。
插件市场中的插件名称现在直接打开原作者仓库，Awesome 目录只负责发现和索引。

en.summary: Lets the installed Windows edition use official dsh commands directly in everyday terminals while keeping the Portable edition registration-free.
highlights: Setup can add dsh to the current user's PATH so official plugin commands work in newly opened PowerShell and Command Prompt windows.
Repair never duplicates the entry; moving the installation migrates it, while deselection and uninstall remove only the installer-owned path.
Fresh-release protection no longer blocks removal after a plugin has been installed; protection remains active when installing new code.
Shutdown clears rebuildable absolute links so moving the complete Portable folder works consistently across Windows versions.

Complete-package upgrades no longer leave the tray stuck on Checking; checking, confirmation, download, and installation are separate stages, and the independent updater safely exits DSH, verifies and replaces program files, reopens the new version, and preserves user data.
Plugin names in the market now open the original author's repository; the Awesome catalog remains discovery and index data only.
